notes.title: Rusty Rangers at Summer Next Fest 2025: Demo & Release Dates
notes.content:
[p]The updated Rusty Rangers demo is live now on Steam! [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1599420/view/530973947986971962?l"]Check out the changes[/url] – it’s the perfect time to jump in. We’re eager for your feedback!
[/p][p]The full game launches on [b]June 21, 2025[/b] for Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 4/5. The Steam version (with Steam Deck support) releases [b]July 31, 2025.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/21ab8e71a5fe745699d084bbccd23ed4bc177f0b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Updated for Next Fest — Come Try It Out!
notes.content:
For Steam Next Fest, we’ve dropped a demo update. Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] Controls: Fixed keyboard support + added full mouse support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/790c741d8a97ef23339d01cc77abdce757e963e7.jpg[/img]
[*] Gamepad: Added a loading screen hint: «Use your gamepad, Ranger!»

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/acf650c8ffac51d67967273184b9fb17ae13df94.gif[/img]
[*] Level Design: Added a signpost to elevator rooms in the hub; polished tricky spots in some areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/bba569a947e7d7112c133ae892701f1b60d17ce2.gif[/img]
[*] Balance: Tweaked stats for certain items.
[*] Bugs: What bugs? Squashed a bunch of small issues!
[/list]
[b]Final Sprint:[/b] All hands on deck for Next Fest and our launch later this year. We’ll post more often—share your thoughts and questions! Talking with you matters.

[b]Your turn:[/b]  Jump into the new demo and test it out! We need your feedback to make Rusty Rangers even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/825938d74a387c6d9ea8c7e593bf9124a2265e93.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo updated
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/3472b8959ef1b24bf1205b25dd1bb8ba6f5813d0.png[/img]

We are pleased to present you a new update for the demo version of Rusty Rangers!

List of changes:
- updated tutorial
- updated UX/UI layouts
- added new sounds
- fixed bugs

We really hope you enjoy it. Have a good game!

notes.title: STEAM SCREAM FEST !
notes.content:
Hello friends!
[b]Rusty Rangers[/b] are participants in the Halloween festival [u]Steam Scream Fest [/u]!

Of course, we prepared for the Helloween. We bring to your attention a [b]new extended demo version[/b] of the game with two levels and festive decorations.
 
Also, we listened to the wishes of the players and added continuous shooting and dash.
 
Download and enjoy new content!
